title: I want to play your indie games and give you feedback
author: Tasty-Concern4582
selftext:
Hey guys!

I'm a second-year Game Design and Development student, and I'd love to try out your games!

I have a decent understanding of game design, mechanics, UI and player experience, so hopefully I can give you some useful and constructive feedback.

Feel free to drop your games in the comments, whether they're early prototypes, demos or finished projects.

I'm also developing my own indie game, so I'll leave a link to its beta here in case anyone wants to try it and give me some feedback too!

[https://vfian.itch.io/rog-chess](https://vfian.itch.io/rog-chess) (There's a feedback questionnaire in the description if you'd like to share your thoughts! [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdg\_E6nnsYGdU1-e2B9Dq3G0lVDqVPjTWUBJOvYsviYXfsWQA/viewform?usp=header](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdg_E6nnsYGdU1-e2B9Dq3G0lVDqVPjTWUBJOvYsviYXfsWQA/viewform?usp=header) )

Looking forward to seeing what you guys are working on!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Tasty-Concern4582 this post needs more detail on how you used AI in development. Saying you used AI isn't the same as explaining how. Rule 4 asks promotional posts to contribute by talking about the process. We're trying to keep "check out my game" posts from taking over the sub. If you don't update, this may be removed.
